Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR CIFE Young Professional-II Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR CIFE YP-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 22 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional-II post?
faq.answer: A postgraduate degree in Fisheries Science, Food Technology, Fish Processing, MBA, Agribusiness, or a related discipline with a 1st Division or 60% marks is required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Young Professional-II position?
faq.answer: The age limit is between 21 years and 45 years, with relaxation as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-II post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a fixed monthly salary of Rs. 42,000.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview in person.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional-II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Young Professional-II post.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and any other relevant documents.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the ICAR CIFE located?
faq.answer: ICAR Central Institute of Fisheries Education is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra, with the pincode 400061.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Walk-in Interview.
